theme_central: A symmetrical arc: man starts from absolute embryonic insignificance and ends, if pious, raised to the rank of a sovereign directly thanked by his Creator in Paradise.
sources_note: 5-section structure precisely sourced (slideshare.net, Al Quran Chapter 76): 1-3, 4-6, 7-10, 12-22, 23-31.

branches.title: Creation, humility
branches.resume: Man was not even a mentionable thing; created from a mingled fluid, guided, free to choose.

children.t: Man's creation from a mingled fluid, guided, free to believe or deny

branches.title: Punishment and reward
branches.resume: Chains and blaze for the disbelievers; a spring scented with camphor for the pious.

children.t: Chains for the disbelievers, spring of camphor for the pious

branches.title: Traits of the pious
branches.resume: Those who fulfill their vows, feed the needy, the orphan and the captive out of love for Allah.

children.t: Vows fulfilled, food given to the needy, the orphan, the captive

branches.title: Description of Paradise
branches.resume: Neither heat nor cold, silver cups clear as glass, the spring of Salsabil, eternal youth, silver bracelets.

children.t: Detailed description of Paradise: springs, cups, ornaments, eternal youth

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Qur'an revealed progressively, patience, prayer at the prescribed hours; the Qur'an as a reminder for whoever wishes to take the path.

children.t: Qur'an revealed progressively, patience, prayer; the Qur'an as a reminder
